method: Same extended production-orchestration probe at three exact revisions, three sequential samples each; controlled ports/provider/receipt delays only. Six equivalent scenarios. No native or live provider/audio.
limits: Input tokens and first audio not observed; bytes are UTF-8 JSON, not tokens.
Warm/cold/long-idle provider behavior is not measured.
Provider outputs are controlled equally; a baseline direct answer does not prove it had sufficient selected-ticket context. Separate assertions verify current first-request context.
Scoped dispatch has exactly one controlled port admission; no coding child or real repository work. The correctness admission classifier adds one 60ms controlled provider round.
